name: Sol Renewed
author: Oddisz
description: A gamified Sol system: the eight planets, Pluto, and the moons that matter, at distances you can actually fly. Ashes of the Domain megastructures on Mars and Pluto, a hypershunt around the Sun, a gate, cross-mod planet conditions, a configurable Remnant presence, a colony crisis that grows with everything you build in Sol, and a quest that brings Sol into the Sector. No radiation.
